mainClass.description: Fully-qualified name of the main class to run.

file.description: Path to the source file declaring the main class (disambiguates classes declared in several files). Supports ${file}.

args.description: Program arguments passed to the main class.

classPaths.description: Override classpath. If empty, the language server resolves it from the project model.

modulePaths.description: Override the JPMS module path (resolved from the project model if empty).

moduleName.description: JPMS module owning the main class, launched as -m moduleName/mainClass.

javaExec.description: Path to the java executable. If empty, the project SDK is used.

cwd.description: Working directory for the launched process.

env.description: Extra environment variables for the launched process.

hostName.description: Host the JVM is listening on.

port.description: JDWP port the JVM is listening on.
